title: The Field Where First Things Are Still Found

features.name: the-finding-house
features.desc-on-touch: A small shed where discoveries rest before they become archive. The sorting never ends.

features.name: the-first-marker
features.desc-on-touch: Unwritten signage marking the place where searching began. The field placed it there, or you did. Now there's no difference.

features.name: the-gathering-object
features.desc-on-touch: Something lost and found and lost and found again. It doesn't remember belonging to anyone.

features.name: the-edge-where-searching-started
features.desc-on-touch: A threshold into the known. Behind it: all the places you have not yet looked.

features.name: the-still-growing
features.desc-on-touch: Things accumulating, becoming archive. The field is teaching itself what it holds.
